metadata.title: fix: resolve duplicate settings import causing undefined name errors
metadata.author: roller100

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

## 📌 Summary
Fixes duplicate import of settings in `mcpgateway/common/validators.py` that caused `undefined name 'config_settings'` errors during linting. The module was importing settings from both `mcpgateway.common.config` and `mcpgateway.config`, but only the latter is valid.

## 🐞 Root Cause
The validators module had:
```python
from mcpgateway.common.config import settings
from mcpgateway.config import settings as config_settings
```

But code referenced `config_settings` on lines 1334 and 1359, causing flake8/pylint errors.

## 💡 Fix Description
- Removed duplicate import from `mcpgateway.common.config`
- Consolidated all references to use `settings` from `mcpgateway.config`
- Fixed 2 remaining `config_settings` references on lines 1334, 1359
- Updated test references in `tests/security/test_validation.py`
- Removed `--cov` from default pytest options for faster test runs

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Status |
|---------------------------------------|--------|
| Lint suite (flake8, pylint)           | ✅ Passed |
| Validator unit tests (72 tests)       | ✅ Passed (72 passed, 3 skipped) |
| Module import test                    | ✅ Passed |

Test output:

commits.message:
fix: update test deep nesting payloads to match new VALIDATION_MAX_JSON_DEPTH=30

The DEEP_NESTING_PAYLOADS in test_input_validation.py only had 11 levels
of nesting, which was sufficient to fail validation when the default
VALIDATION_MAX_JSON_DEPTH was 10. However, after increasing the default
to 30 for compatibility with complex APIs (Notion, Jira, etc.), these
test payloads became valid and the test started failing.

Updated all three payloads to have 35 levels of nesting to properly
test that schemas exceeding the new 30-level limit are rejected.

Fixes CI failures in pytest (py3.11) and pytest (py3.12) jobs.
Related to PR #1868.

Signed-off-by: roller100 <contact@bearingnode.com>

fix: exclude bn-private-collab submodule from package manifest

The check-manifest validation was failing because bn-private-collab is a
git submodule (private collaboration docs) that should not be included
in the source distribution package. Added prune directive and excluded
.gitmodules to align sdist contents with package requirements.

Refs: check-manifest failures in PR #4
